ex.en: If you invert the glass, the water will spill out at once.
ex.zh: 如果把杯子倒过来，水立刻就会洒出来。

words.note: in（向内）+vert（转）→ 使倒转；inverted commas 即引号。

ex.en: Greece is often called the cradle of Western civilization.
ex.zh: 希腊常被称为西方文明的摇篮。

words.note: cradle 指摇篮，也比喻发源地；from cradle to grave 指一生。

ex.en: The course is divided into five discrete units, each tested separately.
ex.zh: 这门课分为五个独立单元，各自单独考核。

words.note: discrete 分离的；discreet 谨慎的，两者拼写易混。

ex.en: The manager gave us an assurance that the goods would arrive on time.
ex.zh: 经理向我们保证货物会准时到达。

words.note: assurance 指口头保证或信心；assure sb of sth 为其动词用法。

ex.en: Her doctor suggested she see a psychiatrist about her sleeping problems.
ex.zh: 她的医生建议她就睡眠问题去看精神科医生。

words.note: psych（心理）+iatr（治疗）+ist；psychologist 是心理师。

ex.en: A rescue squad arrived within minutes of the collapse.
ex.zh: 坍塌发生几分钟后，一支救援队赶到了。

words.note: squad 指执行特定任务的小队，比 team 更具编组色彩。

ex.en: Heavy snow disrupted flights and trains across the north of the country.
ex.zh: 大雪扰乱了该国北部的航班和火车。

words.note: dis（分开）+rupt（断）→ 打断、扰乱，常用于服务与秩序。

ex.en: The accident left a long scar on his left arm.
ex.zh: 那次事故在他左臂上留下一道长长的伤疤。

words.note: scar 可指肉体伤疤，也可指心理创伤，常用复数。

ex.en: The sergeant ordered his men to search the empty building.
ex.zh: 中士命令手下搜查那栋空楼。

words.note: sergeant 是军警军衔，注意拼写中 g 后的 ea 与 nt。

ex.en: Clean water is vital to the health of every community.
ex.zh: 清洁的水对每个社区的健康都至关重要。

words.note: vital 后接 to 或 for；含“生命”义，比 important 语气强。

ex.en: Our neighbour is a little eccentric, but everyone likes him.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居有点古怪，但大家都喜欢他。

words.note: ec（出）+centr（中心）→ 偏离中心的，故指古怪反常。

ex.en: The two countries have been in conflict for more than a decade.
ex.zh: 两国冲突已持续十多年。

words.note: 作名词重音在前，作动词在后；a conflict of interest 常考。

ex.en: Repairing household appliances is often cheaper than replacing them.
ex.zh: 修理家用电器通常比更换更便宜。

words.note: appliance 多指家用电器；apply 加 -ance 构成，注意拼写。

phr.en: an alloy of copper and zinc

ex.en: The frame is made of a light alloy that resists rust.
ex.zh: 这个框架由一种防锈的轻合金制成。

words.note: alloy 是金属混合物；alloy 作动词读 /əˈlɔɪ/。

ex.en: He is under the delusion that everyone agrees with him.
ex.zh: 他抱有错觉，以为大家都同意他。

words.note: delusion 是自我欺骗的错觉；illusion 多指视觉或表面假象。

ex.en: Mass production brought cars within reach of ordinary families.
ex.zh: 批量生产使汽车进入普通家庭的购买范围。

words.note: the masses 指民众；a mass of 后接可数或不可数名词。

ex.en: The device can detect tiny amounts of gas in the air.
ex.zh: 这个装置能检测出空气中的微量气体。

words.note: detect 强调用仪器或感官发现不易察觉之物；名词 detection。

ex.en: Please update the software before you connect to the office network.
ex.zh: 连接办公网络前请先更新软件。

words.note: update 作动词重音在后，作名词可重音在前，均可。

ex.en: The city is enjoying a renaissance after years of decline.
ex.zh: 这座城市在多年衰落后正经历复兴。

words.note: re（再）+naiss（生）+ance → 复兴；首字母大写指文艺复兴。

ex.en: The workers were told to leave because poisonous gas had escaped.
ex.zh: 工人们被告知撤离，因为有毒气体泄漏了。

words.note: poisonous 指本身有毒；toxic 更常用于工业、化学语境。

ex.en: World leaders condemned the attack on the hospital as a crime.
ex.zh: 各国领导人谴责对医院的袭击是犯罪行为。

words.note: condemn 既指公开谴责，也指判刑；后接 as 表“斥为”。

ex.en: Students can ask for assistance if they cannot pay the fee.
ex.zh: 学生付不起费用时可以申请援助。

words.note: assistance 比 help 正式，常与 give、offer 搭配。

ex.en: The old painting was sold at auction for a record price.
ex.zh: 那幅旧画在拍卖会上以创纪录的价格成交。

words.note: at auction 表“以拍卖方式”，前面不加冠词。

ex.en: The small engine is strong enough to propel the boat upstream.
ex.zh: 这台小发动机足以推动小船逆流而上。

words.note: pro（向前）+pel（推）→ 推进；propeller 即螺旋桨。

ex.en: He finally admitted that he had copied the report from a website.
ex.zh: 他最终承认报告是从网站上抄袭的。

words.note: admit 后接动名词或 that 从句，不接 to do；admit to 也可。

ex.en: The path is uneven, so watch your step in the dark.
ex.zh: 这条路不平，天黑时小心脚下。

words.note: un（不）+even（平）→ 不平的，也指发展、分配不均衡。

ex.en: The dictionary gives a clear definition of the term for beginners.
ex.zh: 这本词典为初学者提供了该术语的清晰定义。

words.note: by definition 常置于句首，表“按定义必然如此”。

ex.en: They bought a huge mansion in the countryside last summer.
ex.zh: 他们去年夏天在乡下买了一栋巨大的宅邸。

words.note: mansion 指豪华大宅；manse 是牧师住宅，勿混。

ex.en: Health workers asked everyone to wear a mask on public transport.
ex.zh: 卫生工作者要求大家在公共交通上戴口罩。

words.note: mask 作名词指面罩，作动词指掩饰，比 hide 更书面。

ex.en: Soldiers patrol the border every night in small groups.
ex.zh: 士兵每晚分成小组巡逻边境。

words.note: patrol 作动词重音在后；on patrol 是固定搭配。
